template.name: Planner
template.declaration: clock cp; int ds = 0; int ss = 0;

transition.label: t : int[0,MAXT-1]
ds < NB_U && ss < MAX_SALVO_U && ammoU_b[ds] > 0 && inflU_b[ds] < CH_PER_U[ds] && best_u_b_salvo(ds) >= 0 && t == best_u_b_salvo(ds)
assign_u[ds][t]!
ammoU_b[ds]--, inflU_b[ds]++, upCnt_bt[ds][t]++, shots_u_fired++, ss++
ds < NB_U && (ss >= MAX_SALVO_U || ammoU_b[ds] == 0 || inflU_b[ds] >= CH_PER_U[ds] || best_u_b_salvo(ds) < 0)
ds++, ss = 0
t : int[0,MAXT-1]
ds >= NB_U && ds < NB_U + NB_L && ss < MAX_SALVO_L && ammoL_b[ds - NB_U] > 0 && inflL_b[ds - NB_U] < CH_PER_L[ds - NB_U] && best_l_b_salvo(ds - NB_U) >= 0 && t == best_l_b_salvo(ds - NB_U)
assign_l[ds - NB_U][t]!
ammoL_b[ds-NB_U]--, inflL_b[ds-NB_U]++, loCnt_bt[ds-NB_U][t]++, shots_l_fired++, ss++
ds >= NB_U && ds < NB_U + NB_L && (ss >= MAX_SALVO_L || ammoL_b[ds - NB_U] == 0 || inflL_b[ds - NB_U] >= CH_PER_L[ds - NB_U] || best_l_b_salvo(ds - NB_U) < 0)
ds++, ss = 0

query.comment: S1 Deadlock-free
S2u Upper ammo per battery never negative
S2l Lower ammo per battery never negative
S3 Upper in-flight per battery <= channels
S4 Lower in-flight per battery <= channels

query.formula: A[] forall (b : int[0,NB_U-1]) forall (t : int[0,MAXT-1]) (upCnt_bt[b][t] <= MAX_SALVO_U)
query.comment: S5 Upper salvo bound

query.formula: A[] forall (b : int[0,NB_L-1]) forall (t : int[0,MAXT-1]) (loCnt_bt[b][t] <= MAX_SALVO_L)
query.comment: S6 Lower salvo bound
S7 Terminal counters bounded

query.formula: A[] forall (b : int[0,NB_U-1]) forall (t : int[0,MAXT-1]) (upCnt_bt[b][t] > 0 imply engU_b[t][b])
query.comment: RD1 No upper fire outside (range AND altitude) window

query.formula: A[] forall (b : int[0,NB_L-1]) forall (t : int[0,MAXT-1]) (loCnt_bt[b][t] > 0 imply engL_b[t][b])
query.comment: RD2 Same for lower
T1 Planner period deadline
L1 Every threat eventually terminates
R1 Full-intercept reachable
R2 Both upper batteries simultaneously firing
R3 Both lower batteries simultaneously firing
R4 Layered intercept on threat 0
R5 Leakage reachable (saturation)

query.formula: E<> exists (b : int[0,NB_U-1]) exists (t : int[0,MAXT-1]) (upCnt_bt[b][t] == MAX_SALVO_U)
query.comment: SV1 A battery actually fires a full salvo at some threat
E1 Planner always at one of its two locations
E2 decision-step counter in valid range
E3 Both layers receive Planner assignments
SMC1 Probability of full intercept within 40 time units
SMC2 Expected max killed over 200 runs
SMC3 Expected total shots (consumption)
SMC4 50-trace plot
